sections.Profile:
"Shamrock" is a playing card-themed pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Inder in 1977. The game was produced in two versions: a single-player electro-mechanical (EM) version and a four-player EM version. Both versions feature two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, four captive balls, and four kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Gambling, Card games, Original Theme, 1970s
